The Best Interior Designers in Gurgaon Create Beautiful and Functional Spaces

Homes, offices and salons across Gurgaon, from the DLF phases to Sushant Lok.

Beautiful and functional interiors are comfortable and adapt to how people use them. They improve any space, including homes, offices, salons, and commercial spaces.

Designs by 9th Corner express our clients' needs, lifestyle, and taste by incorporating simple yet intelligent spatial design and execution. As the best interior designers in Gurgaon, we focus on these aspects.

Design Begins With You

Different clients have differing needs.

Some people may desire a minimalist and modern home, while others want a maximalist and opulent home. Some businesses want an office that makes their work easier. An optimum combination of spatial design and finishes may also enhance their customer interactions.

In order to begin designing, we highly consider our clients.

We analyse the size of the property, how the space will be used, the client’s preference, the budget, the storage and lighting, and the style.

A Simple Process

Interior design is a complex process, but this doesn’t mean it has to be complicated.

We discuss the project with our clients and study the space. Then we make the layout.

We consider the use of the room, design the storage, place the furniture, choose the lighting, and incorporate designs with different finishes and materials.

Clients can understand a design better and make needed changes earlier if they get to see the design in a 3D perspective.

Transparency is the watchword of the process, from idea to execution.

Residential Interior Design in Gurgaon

We believe every home should be tailored to its occupant's needs.

When designing and decorating the interiors of homes, we consider the overall comfort of family members, the ease of movement, storage, lighting, and the members' personal style.

We can design and decorate the living areas and the kitchen, bedrooms and dining areas, as well as the wardrobes and other service areas of the home, to the family's needs.

Different kinds of homes in Gurgaon, from an apartment to an independent bungalow, require different designs.

A smaller home may need more intelligent space design and storage. A larger home may allow more customisation and greater design flexibility for living areas with elaborate lighting systems and more luxurious finishes.

Our aim is to create a beautiful home without sacrificing ease of use.

Office Interior Design in Gurgaon

Comfort is as important in the design of a workspace as it is in the design of a home workspace.

Designing an office can include the layout of workstations, cabins, meeting rooms, storage, and common areas along with the reception.

In designing an office, we ensure that the layout is flexible and provides ample working space for the employees.

Comfort, needs of the workplace, and design all should be in balance, even in a smaller office or larger workplace.

Best Salon Interior Design in Gurgaon

A salon is more than just an appointment-booking space. Creating the perfect space means clearing room for staff to operate while providing customers a comfortable environment to relax.

Structurally, designing a salon is about creating a reception area and waiting space. It's also about designing a space for mirrors, styling stations, wash areas, and storage with consideration for overall room design and placement of furniture and lighting.

Lighting makes a big difference in a salon space. Well-placed lighting creates a pleasant yet productive atmosphere in a salon. Careful design of a salon can improve the overall customer experience as well as a staff member's ability to fulfil their daily duties.

Practical Use of Space

A big part of good design is optimising the space available.

We create an illusion of functional space within a room by using well-placed storage and furniture.

Clarity of use combined with well-placed decor in a large room creates a space of comfort.

We incorporate design strategies for movement, furniture, storage, and room use before indulging in decorative details.

Designing a space is equally about functionality as it is about aesthetics. A proper design ensures that every available space in a room is put to appropriate use and not wasted.

Materials, Lighting, and Colours

Colours and materials used in a design can completely set the mood a room brings.

Light colours, warm materials, and the right lighting all affect the feeling of a space.

Think of 9th Corner.

The design of each of these elements is carefully coordinated.

Matching the design of the floor, walls and ceiling, as well as the furniture, lights, fabrics, handles and other details, creates a more complete and coordinated design.

Using the same design language for each element eliminates the sense of each element being disparate.

Why Hire a Top Interior Design Company in Gurgaon?

Choose the right design team, and it makes the design process much easier for you.

Here are a few of the things you can expect to guide you throughout your design project:

  • Help with maximising space
  • Creative design for placement of furniture
  • Options for hidden storage
  • Planning for different ways to light a room
  • Suggestions for a variety of colours and types of materials
  • Visual aids of the design
  • Drawing up the best possible design
  • Coordination and supervision of the design implementation

A quality design team will give you the guidance you need without forcing you to take on too many last-minute decisions.

A well-executed design harmonises the process of managing a project.

Designing to Meet Different Needs

Not everyone wants the same style of design, and that is for good reason.

When you think of a family home, you think of creating a design that is useful and inviting. A luxury home may need design details of a different calibre. An office may need to accommodate movement of staff and a design for customers. A salon may need to support customer convenience.

This is why we take into consideration the essence of each brief.

Modern design may be employed as a combination of different styles unified by the function and purpose of the design. At the end of the day, it is most important that the design feels right to the client.

Design and Functionality Overlap at 9th Corner

We care as much about the end-user experience of our design as we do about the design itself. From our first client briefings to the last step of the process, we strive to bring together the best aesthetics and functionality. Our number one priority is to give each client a complete design that encapsulates all their unique needs.

As Gurgaon’s top interior design firm, we want our clients to savour the entire design process. We take special care to listen to our clients while designing, offering them the opportunity to have a greater appreciation for the design itself.

FAQs – Interior Designers in Gurgaon

What should I consider while hiring an interior designer?

It is important for clients to hire a design team that understands their space, lifestyle, daily needs, and budget. It is equally as important to consider the portfolio, experience, communication, and overall planning of the design team.

Does 9th Corner work on interior design projects in Gurgaon?

Yes. Based on the specific needs and wants of a client, we design interiors of homes, salons, offices, and more.

Do you design salons in Gurgaon?

Yes. As one of the best salon interior designers in Gurgaon, 9th Corner offers designs that include all aspects of a salon, from the reception to the styling stations, waiting area, lighting, mirrors and all of the furnishings.

Do you design offices in Gurgaon?

Yes. 9th Corner designs offices with workstations, cabins, meeting rooms and other requisite services, including storage, furnishings, lighting and seating.

Do you work on luxury residential projects?

Yes. We plan luxury interiors that incorporate customised design, high-end materials, and attention to detail in the design of lighting layouts and finishing touches.

How do I select a leading interior design studio in Gurgaon?

A prospective client reviews a design firm’s portfolio, experience, service offerings, design process, and case studies that showcase past work. During the initial consultation, a client should articulate their needs, budget, and personal style to the firm.

Conclusion

Designing functional spaces that enhance the aesthetics of an environment is the essence of good design.

A well-considered design has the power to elevate the everyday and transform the ordinary into the extraordinary. It can be the distinguishing feature among the competition when launching a business or elevating an existing one. The interior design of a space, be it personal or professional, has the potential to improve the functionality and everyday use of a space.

When searching for the best professional interior designers in Gurgaon, 9th Corner places an emphasis on creating designs that augment the lifestyle and needs of the client.

For design clients that fall within the parameters of the salon industry, particular emphasis is placed on the design framework, aesthetics, and functionality of the staff and user experience.

Prospective clients of 9th Corner can expect a simple design philosophy:

Listening to our clients. Planning to perfection. Designing beautifully. Making it work for you.
